description:
Take control of your money — one day at a time.

NoBuy is the simplest no-spend tracker that helps you break impulse buying habits, build saving streaks, and become more intentional with every purchase decision. No subscriptions, no bank connections, no complicated budgets — just one tap per day.

Join the no-buy challenge and underconsumption movement. Track each day with a single tap, watch your streak grow, and see real progress toward financial freedom.

▸ HOW IT WORKS

Tap "No Spend Today" at the end of each day. Log discretionary purchases honestly. Mark mandatory expenses (rent, bills, groceries) — they never break your streak.

▸ STREAK TRACKER

Build consecutive no-spend day streaks and celebrate milestones at 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, and 100 days. Unlock achievement badges. Use Streak Freeze to protect your progress when life happens.

▸ BEHAVIORAL TOOLS — UNIQUE TO NOBUY

• Urge Surfing Timer — Feeling the impulse? Start a 10-minute mindfulness countdown. Most urges pass within minutes.
• Impulse Buy Checklist — Answer honest questions before any purchase. Make decisions, not impulses.
• Waiting List — Add items and revisit them later. 80% of impulse buys feel unnecessary after 24 hours.

▸ TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

• Calendar View — See your month at a glance with color-coded days
• Monthly Stats — Track your no-spend percentage and savings estimate
• Custom Challenges — Set 7-day, 30-day, or any duration goal
• Daily Tips — Research-backed insights to stay motivated

▸ DESIGNED FOR YOUR JOURNEY

• No-Buy Challenge & No-Spend Challenge participants
• Low-Buy Year and underconsumption followers
• Minimalist and frugal living enthusiasts
• Anyone saving for a goal — vacation, emergency fund, debt freedom
• People breaking impulse shopping and stress spending habits

▸ WHY ONE TAP WORKS

Unlike complex budget apps, NoBuy asks one powerful question each day: Did you make an unnecessary purchase?

Research shows spending awareness alone can increase savings by up to 20%. NoBuy turns that awareness into a daily habit with streaks, milestones, and achievements that keep you motivated.

▸ PRIVACY FIRST

Your data stays on your device — always. No account required. No tracking. No data collection. Your financial habits are your business.

▸ WHAT'S INCLUDED FREE

Daily logging, streak tracking, calendar view, basic stats, 3 essential expense categories, smart reminders, urge surfing, impulse checklist, and daily tips.

▸ GO PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE — NO SUBSCRIPTION)

Unlock unlimited categories, CSV export, enhanced sharing cards, unlimited streak freezes, challenges, and all premium themes. Pay once, own forever.

Download NoBuy today and start your first no-spend streak. Your future self will thank you.
